summary: Scammers impersonated police officers and Ledger support through phone calls and email to convince the victim to trust a fabricated fraud investigation. The victim confirmed owning a Ledger device but ended the calls before disclosing sensitive information or moving funds.
user_mistake: Confirmed ownership of a hardware wallet to unsolicited callers
prevention: End unsolicited security calls and contact the company through official channels / Never disclose wallet ownership to unknown callers
